description: This source file defines custom attributes related to stream subscription in Orleans, including ImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute and RegexImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute. These attributes are used to mark grains for implicit stream subscriptions with various namespace predicate options.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute
classes.description: An attribute used to mark grains with implicit stream subscription settings based on namespace predicates.

classes.name: RegexImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute
classes.description: A specific attribute inheriting from ImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute that filters stream namespaces using a regular expression.

methods.name: GetBindings
methods.description: Generates stream binding configurations for the annotated grain class, including namespace predicates and key types.
